description: Where the playing is and its shape: playing, tuning up, count-ins, false starts, endings, sections, and loops, from the frames series and rhythm's onsets and beats. Decodes nothing.

playing.description: stretches of sustained sound that is not tuning up

tuning.description: tuning up: held single pitches outside the playing; label the pitch classes held, in order; value the confidence

count_ins.description: from the first of three or more regular onsets to the playing they lead into; label clicks=<n> interval=<s>; value the confidence

false_starts.description: playing no longer than false_start_max_ms followed by more within restart_max_ms; label restart=<how much more alike the openings are than chance, 0 to 1>; value the confidence

endings.description: each playing stretch's decline to the threshold; label stop, fade, or abrupt; value the confidence

sections.description: each playing stretch cut at self-similarity novelty peaks; label A, B, ... within the stretch, alike sections alike; value the novelty at the start

loops.description: stretches repeating one period loop_min_repeats or more times in a row; label period=<s> repeats=<n> [beats=<n>]; value the confidence

novelty.description: section novelty, clipped to [0, 1]; row k is the boundary at the start of block k (block_frames frames); 0 outside playing and where the kernel does not fit

floor_db.description: the noise floor when the recording has one (floor true): the median level of the lowest floor_band_db band holding floor_min_ms of steady, onset-free frames at least floor_depth_db below the reference; otherwise the 5th percentile frame level

floor.description: whether the recording has a noise floor to measure from: false for a mastered recording, which is then measured from the reference alone and has no tuning, count-ins, or false starts

threshold_db.description: the level above which a frame is active
